title: Want in on Anthropic Before the IPO? Buy These 8 Stocks

Anthropic is barreling toward what could be the largest IPO in history, with investors and bankers reportedly targeting a valuation near $2 trillion and a raise exceeding $86 billion when the offering launches as soon as mid-October — but retail investors still can't buy Anthropic stock directly.

The next best thing: eight publicly traded companies that already hold direct equity stakes, several of which are big enough to move the parent stock on earnings day.

Don't Miss:

  • A single bad hire can set a startup back years. Here are the 5 hires founders most often misjudge — and why

  • Still Learning the Market? These 50 Must-Know Terms Can Help You Catch Up Fast

1. Amazon.com Inc — Anthropic's largest backer committed up to $33 billion total, including a fresh $5 billion tranche tied to an April 2026 deal in which Anthropic agreed to spend more than $100 billion on AWS cloud technology over the next decade. Amazon's 10-Q already booked billions in fair-value gains as notes converted to equity.

2. Alphabet Inc — Google invested $13.3 billion since late 2022 and committed up to $40 billion more in cash and Google Cloud TPU capacity. Alphabet's own filings mark its combined Anthropic and SpaceX private stakes at roughly $124 billion.

3. Microsoft Corp — Committed up to $5 billion in November 2025 alongside a new Azure compute partnership, part of a broader push to diversify beyond OpenAI.

4. NVIDIA Corp — Pledged up to $10 billion the same week, a deal that helped push Anthropic's valuation toward $350 billion at the time and deepened Nvidia's ties across every major AI lab.

Trending: Avoid the #1 Investing Mistake: How Your 'Safe' Holdings Could Be Costing You Big Time

5. Salesforce — The software giant has invested through Salesforce Ventures in every Anthropic round since 2023, starting with roughly $50 million. The stake is now worth about $5.1 billion, and a $2.6 billion unrealized gain contributed $2.53 to adjusted earnings per share in its fiscal second quarter report, helping send Salesforce shares up 23% in a single session.

6. Zoom Communications — An approximately $97 million bet placed via Zoom Ventures back in May 2023 has ballooned to a $3.13 billion stake as of Zoom's latest quarterly filing.

7. SK Telecom Co Ltd — The Korean telecom giant's original $100 million check from 2023 has grown into a stake worth roughly $2.5 billion, and management added to the position in 2026 rather than sell ahead of a possible IPO.
